title: High spots and best job
summary: She enjoyed big audiences and says she made the most money at the Nest Club.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Lizzie, do you recall any particular anecdotes that you remember now more than anything else about the old days? Is there anything in particular you look back upon and remember? Any?
In regards, I remember everything that happened. It was about a little girl about five years old. I remember everything. I don't, you mean anything that impressed me. Yeah. What are your high spots?
Yeah. A high spot in your life, in the past.

Well, I tell ya, I enjoyed singing on, being to the public, you know, bigger the crowd, but then I, you know, see? I enjoyed that. That thing impressed me whenever we, I walked out with a bed, it was a big audience and something like that. Is that what you mean? Yeah.
What was your best job? What, what job did you like best of all? Well. As far as the crowd and everything?

Well, I liked everywhere I ever worked. I, I liked it because I always got along nice with the people. The people always liked me. And, uh, of course I made more money at the Nest Club than any club I ever placed, any place I ever, ever worked, you know, in regards to money, you know, with tips, you know, from the customers and things of that sort.
